name: vk_gltf_renderer v2026.11.2 (NVIDIA Vulkan RTX path tracer & glTF editor)
summary: NVIDIA's open-source Vulkan ray-tracing renderer and PBR material reference for glTF 2.0, with a built-in scene editor (hierarchy, materials, gizmo, save back to glTF), RTX path tracer, DLSS Ray Reconstruction / OptiX / OIDN denoising and 36+ glTF extensions. v2026.11.2 adds beta caustics, a texture isolate view, a universal path-tracer shader and faster start-up. Prebuilt Windows and Linux binaries.

access.notes: Needs a Vulkan 1.4 GPU with ray tracing (RTX recommended); Windows or Linux only. DLSS/OptiX features depend on NVIDIA hardware.

procedure: Open the v2026.11.2 release page on GitHub.
Unpack and run; drag a .gltf/.glb scene into the window.
Or build from source with CMake (see README Requirements).

verdict.why: Reference-grade glTF path tracer from NVIDIA, Apache-2.0 verified, fresh release with downloadable binaries (446 stars). Niche: best for look-dev / material checks, needs an RTX-class GPU.
